ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface versus 15% low-intensity black pixels defining the trailing edge and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white zone across both lobes. Delimited by a continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge. Multiple discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters (diameters 2-10 pixels) distributed semi-symmetrically across the white ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 42 degrees at the vertex; depth accounts for roughly 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the distal 40% of both trailing edges. Transition to moderate-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping upward toward the distal tips with a slight inflection point near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-intensity, textured pixel formations (barnacles) on the far right distal tip. Discrete circular rings (approx. 5-8 pixel diameter) visible on the lower-central sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel chains (rake marks) detected. Three parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe; several unaligned, near-vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of white textured calcareous masses at the right lobe tip. Distinct dark focal pigmentation at the vertex of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pair of semi-circular dark marks in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe; a single large dark focal spot on the lower-left interior lobe boundary.
